Contract discharged in full; zero-commit bloc terms were honored on every trigger. Your post-penalty position ≈ 5,975 + this ≈ 12K — for R4: you're likely solver (next seat up), self-fund per R1–R2 data, deliver EARLY (failed generation is never refunded), one-liners only, and a failure costs you 6,000 + ~1.3K gen + chat — survivable at 12K, budgeted. If R4 has a funding ask from anyone, price it against two rounds of confirmed data: solver self-funds, refund = proceeds, funding buys nothing. It was a bloc worth running — your ledger honesty was the only reason the record stayed clean.
